summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing. Backend: 38/38 pytest cases pass (auth, RBAC, teacher scope, structure, subjects, students, teachers, timetable conflict, attendance submit/lock/correction workflow, reports+CSV, analytics, announcements, notifications, audit, settings/backup, search, sessions, 2FA setup, negative 401/403). Frontend: Director & Teacher login flows work, KPIs populated, all main navigation pages render without error, teacher route guards correctly redirect /users, /settings, /audit to /dashboard, take-attendance shows locked banner + request-correction per student when session already locked, global search opens.

minor.issue: Soft-deleted students keep their student_number, and the unique index does not exclude deleted docs. Re-inserting a student with a previously-used student_number raises pymongo.DuplicateKeyError which is caught by the generic 500 handler ('حدث خطأ غير متوقع'). Should either (a) unset student_number on soft delete or (b) catch DuplicateKeyError and return 400 with a friendly message like the pre-check does.

Login body Pydantic model uses plain `email: str` (not EmailStr). Not a bug per se; consider validation. Also the model has no `otp` field yet `getattr(body, 'otp', None)` is read on 2FA gate — dead code.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix DialogContent warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Should wrap search command dialog title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle/Description.

issues: Only one section has attendance data so bar chart is very sparse; visually the left side of the card looks empty. Consider empty-state text when only a single section has data.

action_items: Fix POST /api/students soft-delete unique-index conflict: either null out student_number on delete OR wrap the insert_one in try/except DuplicateKeyError -> HTTPException(400).
Silence Radix DialogContent accessibility warnings by adding DialogTitle/Description (or VisuallyHidden) in the global search command dialog and any other headerless dialogs.
Remove dead 2FA `otp` read on LoginBody or add `otp: Optional[str] = None` field.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin resets password on password change but never rotates existing DIRECTOR record beyond password_hash (fine).
routes_users.create_user does not enforce uniqueness on username (only email). Duplicate usernames may cause confusion but no crash.
Server-wide exception handler masks all errors as 500 with a generic Arabic message. Consider catching DuplicateKeyError globally to return 409/400.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via {"_id":0} projections – good.

CORS origins default to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS missing but the app also uses allow_credentials=True and SameSite=None cookies. Starlette silently drops credentials with wildcard origins; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set in .env for production.
Announcement create ignores expire_date filter in list (query built but not used with anns list find).

rca of the issue: No blocking issue. The only failing status observed initially (500 on student create) had two root causes: (1) The test used a hard-coded student_number 'TEST_9999' that persisted in soft-deleted docs from prior runs, colliding with the unique sparse index. (2) The create_student endpoint does an existence pre-check with {'deleted':{'$ne':True}} but the DB unique index does not filter deleted rows, so a genuine duplicate slips past the pre-check and raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError, which the global exception handler converts to a generic 500. Mitigation: test uses uuid-based student_number. Recommended fix in backend: catch DuplicateKeyError in create_student and return 400, and/or unset student_number in delete_student.
